exercise.task: Find the highest output_w row and annotate its own area_m2/output_w pair as Peak, with offset (8, 8) points and an arrow. Keep the prepared observations; arrange and display fig.
exercise.solution:
peak = df.loc[df["output_w"].idxmax()]
ax.annotate(
    "Peak",
    xy=(peak["area_m2"], peak["output_w"]),
    xytext=(8, 8),
    textcoords="offset points",
    arrowprops={"arrowstyle": "->"},
)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
